title: Add symmetrical selection option to bone map editor
body: Fixes https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/12382 This PR adds a bone mirroring tool to the `BoneMap` resource: The original and mirrored fields act as a case insensitive search and replace. so they'll work with all bone names: | Original, Mirrored | Bones Mirrored | | ------------- | ------------- | | .L, .R | LeftUpperArm.L -> RightUpperArm.R | | _L_, _R_ | J_Bip_L_UpperArm -> J_Bip_R_UpperArm | Existing selections won't be overwritten so if you've manually selected something you don't have to worry about losing it when using the tool. The caveat to this tool is that it assumes the profile bone names start with 'Left' and 'Right' (like `SkeletonProfileHumanoid` bone names). If you create a custom profile with custom bone names that don't use Left/Right prefixes this tool won't work.
